definitions.explanation: A spiny marine animal whose gonads (roe) are considered a delicacy in Japanese cuisine.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新鮮|しんせん}→新鮮：03261_shinsen⟧なうに⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
⟦{北海道|ほっかいどう}→北海道：11010_hokkaidou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧うに⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{産地|さんち}→産地：04031_sanchi⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧だ。
examples.english: Hokkaido is famous as a sea urchin producing region.

notes:
うに refers to both the sea urchin animal and its edible roe. In food contexts, it specifically means the gonads, prized as a delicacy.

WRITING:
Several kanji exist: {雲丹|うに} (processed/salted roe), {海胆|うに} or {海栗|うに} (the animal). Hiragana うに is standard in most contexts.

COMMON DISHES:
- うに{丼|どん}: sea urchin rice bowl
- うに⟦{軍艦|ぐんかん}{巻|ま}き→軍艦巻き：15214_gunkanmaki⟧: sea urchin battleship sushi
- うに⟦パスタ→パスタ：06768_pasuta⟧: sea urchin pasta
- うに⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{刺身|さしみ}→刺身：04023_sashimi⟧: raw sea urchin

CULTURAL NOTE:
Considered one of the top sushi toppings alongside ⟦まぐろ→マグロ：11134_maguro⟧ (tuna) and いくら (salmon roe). ⟦{北海道|ほっかいどう}→北海道：11010_hokkaidou⟧ is especially famous for high-quality うに. Fresh うに is expensive; the best varieties can cost several thousand yen per piece at sushi restaurants.
